zh.title: Allegiant Air將於特定客機推出頭等艙並提供免費飲料
zh.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，航空公司 Allegiant Air 準備在特定客機上引進頭等艙服務，逐步超越過往的基礎飛行型態。全新的高級客艙將配備尺寸更大的座位，並向搭乘該客艙的乘客提供免費飲料服務，為旅客帶來更豐富的客艙體驗選擇。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，航空公司 Allegiant Air 正準備在旗下特定客機上引進頭等艙服務。這項新產品顯示該航空公司正逐漸超越過往單純提供基礎飛行的服務模式，並向乘客提供更高規格的客艙選擇。
在最新規劃的高級客艙服務中，搭乘特定客機的乘客將能享受到尺寸更大的座椅空間，以及由航空公司提供的免費飲料服務。這項全新推出的高級客艙與座位升級措施，旨在為搭乘 Allegiant Air 特定航班的旅客提供優於基礎飛行的客艙服務。

en.title: Allegiant Air To Introduce First Class Seating And Complimentary Drinks On Select Aircraft
en.summary: Allegiant Air is set to introduce a First Class cabin on select aircraft, marking a shift beyond its traditional bare-bones service model. According to details reported by Simple Flying, the airline's new premium cabin option will feature larger seats for passenger comfort as well as complimentary drinks during flights. The introduction of these upgraded seating choices represents an expansion of the carrier's passenger product offerings on designated aircraft within its fleet.
body: Airlines operator Allegiant Air is preparing to introduce a First Class cabin on select aircraft, according to a report by Simple Flying. The planned service update marks a shift for the carrier as it expands beyond its traditional bare-bones flying model to offer passengers a new premium cabin experience.

Under the upcoming product offering, passengers traveling in the new premium cabin on designated aircraft will have access to larger seats designed for enhanced comfort. In addition to upgraded seating options, Allegiant Air will also provide complimentary drinks to customers flying in these upgraded premium sections.
